description: Unbounded variable-length pattern with lower bound 0 (*0..) matching self and all reachable descendants.

sqlpgq.reason: PostgreSQL SQL/PGQ (experimental: PostgreSQL 19 Beta 1-3 and 20 development builds) does not support element pattern quantifiers such as '->{0,}' (its parser rejects the open upper bound with a syntax error, and bounded forms with 'element pattern quantifier is not supported').
